newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close firmer in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close firmer in thin trade.

text.p: UK grain futures closed firmer on the back of currency factors, but due to a lack of significant buying interest very little business took place.
Wheat futures finished 0.40 to 0.60 stg higher after trading 452 lots, while barley ended 0.25 to 0.50 stg above Wednesday's finish. Barley traded 75 lots.
The delivered market found little to get excited about, and once again only managed the odd trade to cover immediate needs.
